Copilot instructions — EbMS (Java/Maven)

Purpose

These instructions guide AI assistants and contributors interacting with this repository. Focus on Maven multi-module structure, Java 17 conventions, and the maintenance matrix below.

Language & build

- Primary language: Java (JDK 17)
- Build tool: Maven (multi-module). Use top-level parent at ebms-core/pom.xml.
- Common commands:
  - Install: mvn -B install
  - Run tests: mvn -B test
  - Build a module: mvn -pl <module-path> -am package

Testing

- Unit tests use JUnit under src/test/java. Prefer small, deterministic tests.

Review patterns & mined guidance

- When reviewers request changes to APIs in core/, ensure callers in admin/ and plugin/* are updated and tests adjusted.
- When changing DB schema or SQL, update plugin/db/*, test resources (ebms-core/core/resources/test/ebms.yml), and document migration steps.

Maintenance matrix (high-value paths)

- Changing ebms-core/core -> update: ebms-admin webapp, ebms-core/plugin/*, documentation/docs/ebms-core
- Changing ebms-core/plugin/db/* -> update: migrations, test resources at ebms-core/core/resources/test
- Changing ebms-admin webapp -> update: static assets under ebms-admin/src/main/webapp and documentation

What AI agents can do autonomously

- Suggest test improvements and missing unit tests for changed modules
- Create draft PR descriptions and checklist items
- Run static checks and report likely failing tests (don’t push fixes to main without review)

What AI agents must not do

- Do not change release/versioning information without human review
- Do not modify distribution or publishing configuration (distributionManagement) without maintainers’ consent

Notes for contributors

- Branch naming: feature/<short-description> or fix/<short-description>
- Target branch: dev (default)
